checks.label: An ordinary authorized member can use the additional native AVS field
The 84 MiB-plus file uploads through more than 80 resumable native chunks
Native article save publishes the new video record
CCK record, field and file have an explicit native AVS video mapping
Chapter metadata persists in the native record
The native player decodes and plays the uploaded file
The chapter command reaches the actual player
The uploaded file supports bounded HTTP Range reads
The player stays within the 390px mobile viewport
A real native comment stores the video field and timestamp context
Withdrawing the owning record revokes anonymous access to the media
A different member submits a native video rating with CSRF over POST
The native AVS rating data reflects the 4/5 vote
The review-format article saves through the native controller
Two published member reviews average to 4/5 while the editorial score stays 4.5/5
Public structured rating matches the two actually published member reviews
